name: Skyvia
description_en:
Skyvia is a hosted data platform with distinct products for integration, backup, querying, access endpoints and automation. This profile focuses on Data Integration: imports/exports, warehouse replication, two-way synchronization and more complex data/control flows. Buying one product does not automatically include the others.

The integration kind matters. A scheduled export, a replication and a two-way synchronization have different identity, deletion and conflict rules, even when they use the same connection.
description_zh:
Skyvia 是托管数据平台，集成、备份、查询、访问端点和自动化是分别提供的产品。本文聚焦 Data Integration，包括导入／导出、仓库复制、双向同步及更复杂的数据／控制流程。购买其中一种产品不自动包含其他产品。

集成类型很重要：即使使用同一连接，计划导出、复制及双向同步的身份、删除和冲突规则仍不同。

core_features.explanation_en: Maintain an ID map and apply changes in both directions under documented conflict rules.
core_features.explanation_zh: 维护 ID 映射，在文档冲突规则下双向应用变化。

core_features.explanation_en: Select objects, fields, ingestion mode and target schema behavior.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选择对象、字段、提取模式及目标结构行为。

core_features.explanation_en: Use source timestamps where the specific cloud object supports them.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在具体云对象支持时使用源时间戳。

en: Replicate selected cloud objects into a test warehouse.
Evaluate two-way record matching and source-wins conflicts.
zh: 复制所选云对象到测试仓库。
评估双向记录匹配及 Source 优先冲突。

sections.title_en: Start with a defined integration kind
sections.en: Use an import/export for a directed movement, replication for a warehouse copy, and Synchronization only when both systems should accept changes. A proposed trial could import newly created test leads into a disposable list with an explicit destination lookup. The documented recent-record filter needs creation/modification timestamps in the source object; connector availability alone does not establish that capability. Confirm permitted reads and writes before setting a schedule.
sections.zh: 单向移动可用导入／导出，仓库副本用复制，只有两侧都需接受变化时才考虑 Synchronization。建议试验：将新建测试 lead 导入可丢弃列表，明确目标查找。文档近期记录过滤要求源对象具有创建／修改时间戳；存在连接器本身不能证明此能力。设置调度前应确认允许的读取与写入。

sections.title_en: Prepare the first run and decide which side wins
sections.title_zh: 准备初次运行，决定哪侧优先
sections.en: Synchronization initially copies both directions without comparing identical business records, then builds an ID map. An empty side is recommended to avoid duplicates. Later conflicts use Source precedence at whole-record level: a Target-only phone edit can be lost when Source changes the same contact’s email. This is not per-field merging. Test simultaneous edits and deletes before relying on two-way consistency; database identity keys and supported cloud timestamp/insert/update capabilities are prerequisites.
sections.zh: Synchronization 初次运行会双向复制，不先比较相同业务记录，随后建立 ID 映射；文档建议一侧为空以避免重复。之后发生冲突时，Source 在整条记录层面优先：Source 修改同一联系人的邮箱时，Target 单独修改的电话也可能丢失。这不是逐字段合并。依赖双向一致性前应测试同时编辑及删除，并满足数据库自增主键、云对象时间戳及插入／更新能力要求。

sections.title_en: Deletion and schema changes depend on mode
sections.title_zh: 删除与结构变化取决于模式
sections.en: Replication can perform an initial full load then increments. Database New and New-and-modified modes do not track deletes; the reviewed guide limits log-based mode to SQL Server. Schema updates add selected columns/tables while ignoring structural deletions. Full resync can recreate tables, including resync modes that do so regardless of a creation checkbox. Choose a separate target schema and confirm soft/hard deletion settings and downstream dependencies before changing modes or resetting LastSyncTime. No resync or deletion was executed here.
sections.zh: 复制可初次全量后增量运行。数据库 New 及 New-and-modified 模式不跟踪删除；本次指南将日志模式限定为 SQL Server。结构更新添加所选列／表，但忽略结构删除。全量重新同步可能重建表，某些 resync 模式不受创建复选框限制。改变模式或重置 LastSyncTime 前，应采用独立目标 schema，确认软／硬删除设置及下游依赖。本次未执行重新同步或删除。

sections.title_en: Count operations, not distinct business identities
sections.title_zh: 计算处理操作，而非唯一业务身份
sections.en: Current billing counts successful target creates, updates and deletes, including an update writing the same values. Synchronization counts both sides; export counts output CSV rows. A repeated full load can therefore consume more allowance than the number of distinct customers suggests. The subscription guide says a running job can finish beyond quota while later starts are blocked unless additional records are allowed. Keep billing usage and business reconciliation separate; legacy free/basic limits in the same guide do not define current plans.
sections.zh: 当前计费计算成功的目标创建、更新及删除，连写入相同值的更新也算。同步计算两侧，导出计算输出 CSV 行。因此反复全量加载的额度消耗可高于唯一客户数量。订阅指南称，正在运行的任务可超额度完成，之后的新运行会被阻止，除非允许额外记录。应区分计费用量与业务对账；同页旧 Free／Basic 限制不定义当前方案。

sections.title_en: Record volume and scheduling both affect plan choice
sections.title_zh: 记录用量与调度共同影响套餐
sections.en: Integration Free lists 10K records/month, daily runs and two schedules that expire after 30 days. Displayed paid monthly/annual-equivalent prices start at $99/$79 Basic, $199/$159 Standard and $499/$399 Professional, with volume selected separately. Their listed maximum cadence is daily/hourly/one minute and schedule allowance five/fifty/unlimited. Standard extra records are $0.06/1K, Professional $0.02/1K. Confirm the selected volume and exact annual bill; the card amount alone is not a universal all-volume quote. Backup, Query, Connect and Automation are independent subscriptions.
sections.zh: Integration Free 列每月一万记录、每日运行及两个 30 天后过期的调度。付费展示月付／年付折算起价：Basic $99／$79、Standard $199／$159、Professional $499／$399，记录用量另选；所列最高频率依次为每日／每小时／每分钟，调度数为五／五十／无限。Standard 额外每千记录 $0.06，Professional $0.02。应确认所选用量及实际年账单，卡片金额不是所有用量统一报价。Backup、Query、Connect、Automation 独立订阅。

sections.title_en: A sync owner must reconcile records and conflicts
sections.title_zh: 同步负责人需对账并管理冲突
sections.en: Skyvia is worth evaluating for a known source/target pair and explicit movement or replication rules. It is a weaker fit for a requirement that assumes conflict-free simultaneous edits or universal deletion tracking. Evaluate one normal run, an invalid record, concurrent edits and a repeat run against a disposable target. Actual retry/replay semantics, schema recovery, performance, full platform license and UI localization remain unverified; no trial account or production run was used.
sections.zh: 若源目标组合已知，且移动／复制规则明确，可评估 Skyvia。若需求假设两侧同时编辑永无冲突、或所有模式都跟踪删除，适用性较弱。建议在可丢弃目标评估正常运行、非法记录、同时编辑及重复运行。实际重试／重放、结构恢复、性能、完整平台许可及界面本地化仍未核实，本次未使用试用账号或生产运行。
